description:
One value a recipe asks the operator for when it runs.

Never the value: a reading says what will be asked, and what is given for it is
handed to the recipe and said back by nothing.

ask.description: What the operator is asked for it.

name.description: What the input is called, which is what a value is given for it under.

secret.description: Whether the value may be a secret, so a surface takes it without showing it.
